messages:
Sam Warren: Quick announcement: PAT deprecation + OIDC cutover scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. This affects CI secrets using GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN. Full runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/oidc-cutover :mega:
Jess Li: What's the grace period after the cut?
Sam Warren: 48h grace for existing PATs. After that they'll be revoked. Update runners and repo workflows to use OIDC or the `ci-service` account.
Maria Gomez: Will the automation that posts Jira issues from CI break?
Sam Warren: If it calls GH APIs with a PAT, yes. If it uses a GitHub App or our `automation-bot` service, it's fine. See runbook section "jira-automation" for migration snippets.
Noah Patel: Any Dedicated customer notes? We need a plan for token rotation on reserved nodes.
Sam Warren: Dedicated: tokens are fetched via KMS-backed agent; rotation handled by infra playbook `infra/sa-rotation`. Reach out to infra early if you manage on-prem.
Infra Bot: playbook triggered: infra/sa-rotation (owner: Infra Team)
Jess Li: Can someone paste a short test command I can run on a runner to verify OIDC exchange?
Sam Warren: Example (run locally on a runner): curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"audience":"https://token.redwood.ai","repository":"redwood/dev"}' https://sts.internal.redwood/get-oidc-token
Noah Patel: I'll help run a quick smoke test Mon 15:00 PT.
Sam Warren: Preflight Monday 15:00 PT for a handful of repos. Post your repo names if you want them included. File a help ticket for extensions if you can't migrate in time.
